name: Monk Student of the Subtle Body
body:
Students of the subtle body practice kalaripay, a form of martial arts that favors finesse over force and emphasizes the study of anatomy and psychology. The branch of kalaripay focused on inflicting damage and capitalizing on an opponent’s weaknesses employs debilitating pressure strikes targeting vital nerve points. Meanwhile the branch of kalaripay that focuses on repairing damage instructs its practitioners in the use of meditation and therapeutic oils to heal their bodies.

A student of the subtle body has the following class features.

Class Skills

A student of the subtle body adds Heal to his list of class skills, and removes either Knowledge (history) or Ride.

This alters class skills.

Vital Knowledge (Ex)

A student of the subtle body learns to hit smarter, not harder. At 1st level, a student of the subtle body can use his Intelligence modifier in place of his Strength modifier on attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes or monk weapons.

This replaces the 1st level bonus feat.

Ki Pool (Su)

A student of the subtle body gains ki pool at 2nd level rather than 3rd level.

This alters ki pool.

Distillations (Su)

At 2nd level, a student of the subtle body can imbue therapeutic oils with a portion of his own ki energy to create a number of curative distillations equal to 1/2 his student of the subtle body level plus his Intelligence modifier. Each morning, after 8 hours of rest or meditation, a student of the subtle body can spend 10 minutes of preparation and 1 ki point to create his distillations. A distillation, once created, remains potent for 1 day before becoming inert, so a student of the subtle body must re-prepare his distillations every day. A distillation immediately becomes inert if it leaves the student of the subtle body’s possession for longer than 1 round, reactivating as soon as it returns to his keeping. (This allows a student of the subtle body’s distillation to cure a creature other than himself as long as the creature ingests the distillation on the same round in which the student of the subtle body gave it to the creature.) A student of the subtle body’s distillations cure 1d6 points of damage for every two levels the student of the subtle body possesses.

This replaces the 2nd level bonus feat and all instances of style strike.

Anatomical Awareness (Ex)

At 3rd level, a student of the subtle body adds half his class level to all Heal skill checks. Additionally, a student of the subtle body can make a Heal skill check to determine the strengths and weaknesses of a living creature in place of the standard Knowledge skill check that would normally be required. If a student of the subtle body successfully uses Heal to identify a strength or weakness of a creature, he gains a +1 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls against creatures of that type for a number of minutes equal to his student of the subtle body level. This bonus increases by +1 at 7th level and every four levels thereafter.

This replaces ki strike and timeless body.
